newsitem.title: USA: Superior Natl to take $10.4 mln Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Superior Natl to take $10.4 mln Q2 loss.

text.p: Superior National Insurance Group Inc said Tuesday it will take a $10.4 million loss in the second quarter on a $88.6 million debt repayment to Chase Manhattan Bank .
The company said it transferred reinsurance receivables due from Centre Reinsurance Ltd to Chase in exchange for cancellation of the debt.

The long-term debt come from a transaction the company completed on Nov. 14, 1996, in which Chase extended a $93.1 million term loan in exchange for future reinsurance recoveries due from Centre Re to Superior's subsidiary, Superior National Insurance Co.
